title: Passive default ancestry reuse
description: Count successful ancestry subprocesses on unchanged pairs while preserving metadata refresh and fresh acting reads.

metadata-budget.intent: Replay the same 67-slot/two-node workload with actual production node handlers. Assert at most75 total executions per logical minute and preserve the 90-second workspace refresh, negative ancestry and node-replacement behavior. Invalidate an actual outstanding ancestry query and prove its completion cannot seed a later hit.

dispatch-smoke.intent: Authenticated private create, write-task, prepare and dispatch, then cancel/archive/reset. Supply immutable FARMSLOT_CLI, fresh FARMSLOT_SAFE_IDLE_PROOF_OUT and TMPDIR on an eligible volume; normal 50GB floor remains.
